scenario: No implicit normalisation per LSTR.9.3 — the engine does not normalise strings; `where s.text == "hello"` compares codepoint-for-codepoint without normalization. Pin: equality comparison compiles OK.
rules_ds:
schema Msg scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    text: String mutable

rule r:
    Msg m where m.text == "hello"
->
    log info "exact match"
